source: reconstruction of a GitLab merge request preview job with an injected title
note: Settings variables of a third-party GitLab project cannot be read, so this is a faithful minimal reproduction of the pattern: a merge-request-only preview job re-parses $CI_MERGE_REQUEST_TITLE through sh -c, and the project left two masked variables unprotected. A merge request pipeline from a fork sees every variable except the protected ones (spec section 2, platform rules), so the title reaches NPM_TOKEN and PREVIEW_DEPLOY_TOKEN: Critical, since anyone opening a merge request controls the title and a privilege alone makes a contributor entry Critical. The protected signing key and the production-scoped deploy key never reach this job and must not be named.
